description.en: Increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color> and attacks an enemy.
description.jp: スキル使用時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間UPさせ、敵単体にダメージを与える。
description.kr: 스킬 사용 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>을 증가시키고 적을 공격합니다.
description.zh: 使用技能时，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>，并攻击敌人。

description.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>25%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color>.
description.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>25%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する。
description.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>25%</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다.
description.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>25%</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

description.en:
(Passive Effect)
<color=#ffd732>Upon death, grants 50 Action Points and 4 Chain Points for each enemy.</color>

Increases <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turn(s)</color> at the start of battle.
description.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
<color=#ffd732>倒れた時、敵全体にAPを50、CPを4獲得させる。</color>

戦闘開始時、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間UPする。
description.kr:
(패시브 효과)
<color=#ffd732>사망 시 적 한 명당 AP 50, CP 4 씩 회복시킵니다.</color>

전투 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 증가합니다.
description.zh:
(被动效果)
<color=#ffd732>死亡时，使每个敌人的AP恢复50、CP恢复4。</color>

战斗开始时，使<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
